faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How long does a project take?
faq.a1: 1 to 2 weeks for landing pages or simple sites up to 4-6 weeks for custom management apps.
faq.a2: The first month includes free support for any bug fixes.
faq.q3: Will I own the domain and data?
faq.a3: Yes. Domain, code, and data remain 100% your property.
faq.q4: Do I need to provide copy and images?
faq.a4: You can provide them or I can help you structure and write them.
faq.a5: Typically 50% deposit at start and 50% upon final delivery.
